mapper.select: SELECT scenic_id, name, description, location, cover_image, ticket_price, open_hours, avg_score, view_count, favorite_count, comment_count, created_at FROM scenic_spots WHERE status = 1 AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY created_at DESC
